integrity: The theorem is accompanied by a self-contained analytical proof and a standalone reproducibility checker; finite sampling corroborates but does not establish infinite assertions. No independent verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proof applies to a centrally symmetric unit Euclidean ball intersected with positive-width orthogonal centered slabs, in every d>=3. One-slab case is known and not independently claimed. Multi-cut originality is best-knowledge only, and earlier optimal-design or ellipsoid literature may cover an equivalent formulation.
title: Water-filling classification of extremal ellipsoids for ball–box intersections
